name: Armory
author: Sixth Front
description: Earn credits in battle (kills, headshots, knife kills, vehicles, aircraft, captures, revives, wins) and spend them in the ARMORY on the main menu or the deploy screen. Every gun takes a suppressor, compensator or muzzle brake, a heavy or short barrel, a vertical or angled grip, an extended or fast magazine, a laser, special ammunition and finishes up to gold. Upgrades change real stats, show on the gun in your hands and in a 3D preview, and are saved between matches. The suppressor quiets your shots, hides the muzzle flash and keeps you off the enemy minimap.

#menu-armory { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(13,16,18,0.96), rgba(13,16,18,0.9)); padding: calc(28px + var(--safe-t)) 40px calc(28px + var(--safe-b)); }
.ar-wrap { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.ar-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ar-head h2 { margin: 2px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 900; font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 3.2rem); letter-spacing: 0.05em; line-height: 0.95; }
.ar-bank span { display: block; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
.ar-bank b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.9rem; color: var(--signal); font-weight: 600; }
.ar-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 250px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
.ar-guns h3 { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: var(--muted); }

.ar-gun { appearance: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); padding: 9px 12px; color: var(--text); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.86rem; }
.ar-gun em { font-style: normal; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); }
.ar-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; }
.ar-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
.ar-preview { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 60%, rgba(70,78,84,0.55), rgba(13,16,18,0.2)); min-height: 200px; }
.ar-preview canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 200px; }
.ar-preview .ar-name { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 10px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-weight: 900; }
.ar-preview .ar-sub { position: absolute; left: 12px; bottom: 8px; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
.ar-stats { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; justify-content: center; }
.ar-stat { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr 62px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.ar-stat .bar i, .ar-stat .bar s { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; }
.ar-stat b { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--text); text-align: right; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: 600; }
.ar-stat b.up { color: var(--squad); } .ar-stat b.down { color: var(--enemy); }
.ar-slot h4 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: var(--muted); }
.ar-opts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 7px; }

.ar-opt { appearance: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); padding: 9px 10px; color: var(--text); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-height: 74px; }
.ar-opt b { font-size: 0.84rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.ar-opt b i { width: 14px; height: 14px; display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); }
.ar-opt em { font-style: normal; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--signal); margin-top: auto; }
.ar-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 10px; }
.ar-foot p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--muted); max-width: 720px; line-height: 1.4; }
#ar-hud { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--signal); }
#ar-hud .ar-pops { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; }
.ar-pop { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--signal); animation: arPop 2.4s ease-out forwards; }
.ar-pop i { font-style: normal; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.66rem; color: var(--text); letter-spacing: 0.16em; margin-left: 4px; }
@keyframes arPop { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } 10% { opacity: 1; transform: none; } 80% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); } }
.btn .ar-btn-cr { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.78rem; margin-left: 8px; opacity: 0.8; letter-spacing: 0; }
